product_updates.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
product_updates.content: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.

product_updates.title: Elon Musk says ousting Jensen Huang is like ‘kicking Michael Jordan off your team’
product_updates.content: “I don’t think [Huang is] disloyal to the United States," Musk said.

product_updates.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella remains confident in Nvidia after Huang’s exit
product_updates.content: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed confidence in Jensen Huang's successor Colette Kress, who is serving as Nvidia's interim CEO.

product_updates.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
product_updates.content: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.

product_updates.title: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range
product_updates.content: The long-awaited IPO reportedly values the company at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

product_updates.title: Nvidia created a weird bit of intrigue by not filing a routine SEC report
product_updates.content: One Wall Street analyst got to the bottom of Nvidia's surprise announcement that it wouldn't be filing its formal quarterly results document, the 10-Q, for weeks.

product_updates.title: Palmer Luckey warns AI-powered cyberattacks are outpacing defenses: ‘It’s time to start running’
product_updates.content: The Anduril co-founder says outdated technology is leaving systems vulnerable to a new wave of AI-enabled attacks.

product_updates.title: Palmer Luckey thinks China is ‘thrilled to have Jensen out,’ so he wants the ousted Nvidia CEO reinstated
product_updates.content: "It makes America weaker to knock him out," the Anduril CEO said about ousted Nvidia leader Jensen Huang.

product_updates.title: Sam Altman says his life is so weird that he’s unfazed by Andrew Garfield portraying him in upcoming movie
product_updates.content: "It doesn't feel like it's in like the top 10 weirdest things about my life," Altman said.

product_updates.title: Snapchat now lets developers build AR Lenses with AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor
product_updates.content: Lens creators can describe the Lens they want in plain language, and their AI assistant handles the process from start to finish, Snapchat says.
